method: Low-resolution local videos were sampled at ASR claim windows; every frame was inspected at original resolution and hashed. Public screenplay PDFs were rendered locally for page checks, but page images are not distributed with the skill.
global_limit: Frames verify visible pages, subtitles, film compositions or explanatory graphics only. They cannot independently prove motion, sound overlap, edit sequence, cut counts, causal effect or filmmaker intent.
